item.title: Rallying Cry – September 22, 2026
item.description: Young girls in Singapore are inspiring more women in STEM, while Congo rolls out a Canadian-developed vaccine to fight Ebola, and over 100,000 sea turtles nest in Mexico—plus, Gaza’s children return to in-person school for the first time in years!
